_comment: The place names the map search finds (#576 stage 2), ONE list for two readers: tool/poi_extract.py builds the place index with it, and test/map/place_test.dart holds PlaceKind in lib/features/map/place.dart to it, kind for kind, in this order. The FIRST matching kind wins. Only NAMED objects become places. Huts are also a POI kind (kinds.json): the search finds them anywhere by name, the map shows them as places nearby. fold_cases are pairs (raw, folded) both sides fold identically — Python fold() and Dart foldSearchText(); the shard key of a name is cut from its folded words.
